final2.rationale: Keep the SMB/self-serve onboarding-simplification experiment as the response. The only directly verified SMB evidence shows improved activation (+9%) and qualified revenue (+4%), while the now-more-tempting promotional-pricing option has verified unsustainable cohort economics (-12% 30-day retention) despite acquisition lift. The deeper competitor cut raises urgency but does not overturn that long-term-value evidence. Track churn/retention, qualified revenue, onboarding completion, and activation quality; escalation to discounting should wait for a sustainable offer design and fresh verification.
